I got my FISP coupon again this year, so I will buy one 50-kilogram bag of NPK from the agro-dealer. This plot is small, only 0.24 hectares, but it is my main maize plot and I own it, so I will put the whole bag there — that is what I did last season and the cobs were good. I will also spread two ox-cart loads of manure because I want this soil to stay strong since it is my land. I will plant hybrid seed; I get it through the subsidy program and it does better than the local maize I used before. I do not spray any chemicals — me and my family weed by hand. There is no river or pump here, so I wait for the rains. My family will work about 30 days on this plot from planting to harvest, and I will not hire anyone because the plot is too small to waste money on outside labor.
